messages:
maria: hey team — QuillFinance procurement wants a formal pen-test attestation + SOC2 excerpt for the upcoming POC. They specifically asked for wording that references the dedicated POC environment and timeline. Can we confirm what we can share and any lead time? :hourglass:
raj: quick q — do they need the full report or just a signed letter/attestation? full reports are usually redacted.
sam: short answer: we can provide a signed pen-test letter (redacted) that states scope and date, plus a SOC 2 Type II summary / point-in-time report extract. we do not share raw vuln scan output or full third-party reports without an NDA and legal review.
maria: they asked for a one-page attestation they can pass to procurement — mentions "penetration test completed on dedicated POC environment (staging.quill) on 2025-03-10". Is that ok?
sam: we can do that, but we need confirmation of the exact scope name used in our records (we call it "POC – dedicated staging" internally). legal also needs to sign off on the phrasing. also need to confirm whether the customer will accept redacted results or needs the tester to send a letter directly.
raj: operational asks: if they want network diagrams / environment inventory we can supply a sanitized diagram and a short control matrix mapping (SAML, KMS, data residency). also can provide ephemeral staging creds for their security team to run an independent scan — recommend presigned SFTP for artifact exchange, not email.
maria: timeline: POC kickoff 2025-03-17. Procurement wants the attestation by 2025-03-14 to avoid delays. Is that feasible?
sam: tight but doable if we start now. I'll draft the attestation template and post it here for legal. can legal loop @olivia?
olivia: on it — please drop the draft here. need to check with counsel re: redaction language and whether we can name the third-party tester. also confirm pricing impact: if they require a tailored pen test on our dedicated infra for them, that could be a billable request.
maria: noted — procurement asked whether dedicated pricing would change if we run an extra scoped test.
raj: yes — running a custom engagement, or extended retention of logs for their auditors, can be added as a one-time professional service line. i'll flag estimated cost in the SOW draft.
sam: draft attestation v1 (very rough):
```
Redwood Inference hereby attests that a third-party penetration test was conducted against the environment designated as "POC – dedicated staging" on 2025-03-10. The assessment was performed by an independent security firm. Findings requiring remediation were addressed as of 2025-03-13. This attestation is provided for procurement purposes and does not constitute release of the full penetration test report. Requests for the full report must be routed through legal under an NDA.
```
maria: perfect start. can you change the dates to match the actual test date if needed and include contact for sending the redacted report?
sam: will update after legal review.
deploy-bot: Note: please use secure artifact transfer — presigned S3 or SFTP. Do not email attachments with sensitive content.
olivia: legal okayed the basic phrasing but asks to add: "The attestation does not certify compliance with any specific regulatory framework beyond the stated testing activities." also wants one-line describing redaction policy.
sam: updated attestation v2:
```
Redwood Inference hereby attests that a third-party penetration test was conducted against the environment designated as "POC – dedicated staging" on 2025-03-10. The assessment was performed by an independent security firm. Findings requiring remediation were addressed as of 2025-03-13. The attestation does not certify compliance with any specific regulatory framework beyond the stated testing activities. The full penetration test report can be provided under a mutual NDA; our standard redaction policy removes attacker PII and operational secrets. This attestation is provided for procurement purposes and does not constitute release of the full penetration test report.
```
maria: great. i'll send to QuillFinance procurement and cc sales engineering.
raj: for artifacts, i'll prepare a sanitized network diagram + control matrix and upload to presigned S3.
maria: can you confirm ETA for the upload?
raj: aiming EOD 2025-03-12.
olivia: pricing note — if they request their own external test or extended retention, ops/prof services pricing will apply. maria pls flag in the thread and ask them to confirm whether they need an on-prem/full-report handoff.
maria: will ask them now. thanks all — i'll update once they reply. :thumbsup:
